recipe.title: Millet breakfast bowl with edamame and spinach
recipe.description: A warm, savoury bowl of fluffy millet and tender edamame, folded with spinach and brightened with lemon.
steps: Rinse the millet, then simmer it in water until tender, about 15 minutes.
Cook the edamame in water until tender, then drain.
Stir the spinach into the hot millet until it wilts.
Fold in the edamame, olive oil, and lemon juice, then serve warm.

recipe.title: Chickpea & tomato stew
recipe.description: A hearty plant-based stew of chickpeas simmered with tomato and onion.
steps: Soften the onion in olive oil.
Add chopped tomato and chickpeas; simmer 20 minutes.
Stir in spinach until wilted.

recipe.title: Hummus-style chickpea snack bowl
recipe.description: Smashed chickpeas with olive oil and tomato.
steps: Lightly mash the chickpeas.
Stir in olive oil.
Top with diced tomato.

recipe.title: Quinoa with tofu, tomato, and spinach
recipe.description: A colorful skillet dinner with fluffy quinoa, golden tofu, fresh tomato, and wilted spinach.
steps: Rinse the quinoa and simmer it in water until tender, about 15 minutes.
Cut the tofu into cubes and dice the tomato.
Heat the olive oil in a skillet and cook the tofu until golden on several sides.
Add the tomato and spinach, stirring until the spinach wilts.
Fluff the quinoa with a fork and serve topped with the tofu and vegetables.

recipe.title: Rye toast with tofu and avocado
recipe.description: Toasted rye bread topped with a tangy, creamy tofu and avocado spread.
steps: Toast the rye bread until crisp.
Mash the tofu and avocado together in a small bowl.
Stir in the lemon juice.
Spread the mixture over the toast and serve.

recipe.title: Skillet turkey with quinoa and tomato
recipe.description: Tender turkey and fluffy quinoa come together with juicy tomato in a simple skillet meal.
steps: Rinse the quinoa and simmer it in water until tender, about 15 minutes.
Cut the turkey into bite-sized pieces and chop the tomato.
Heat the olive oil in a skillet and cook the turkey until browned and cooked through.
Stir in the tomato and cook for 2 minutes, then serve over the quinoa.

recipe.title: Baked quinoa, chickpea, and edamame bites
recipe.description: Small golden bites with tender quinoa, chickpeas, and edamame, brightened with lemon and parsley.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C and line a baking tray.
Rinse the quinoa, then simmer it in water until tender, about 15 minutes; drain any excess water and let it cool slightly.
Boil the edamame until tender, then drain.
Mash the chickpeas in a bowl, leaving some texture, and stir in the quinoa, edamame, grated carrot, chopped parsley, paprika, salt, and lemon juice.
Drizzle in the olive oil and mix until combined, then shape the mixture into small bites and arrange them on the tray.
Bake for 20–25 minutes, turning the bites once, until golden and firm.

recipe.title: Tofu & vegetable stir-fry
recipe.description: Quick stir-fried tofu with peppers, carrot and rice.
steps: Cook the rice.
Fry the cubed tofu in half the olive oil until golden, then set it aside.
Stir-fry the sliced pepper and carrot in the rest of the oil, return the tofu and combine.

recipe.title: Baked millet casserole with tofu and chickpeas
recipe.description: A savory breakfast bake layered with tender millet, tofu, chickpeas, and vegetables, finished with pumpkin seeds.
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C.
Rinse the millet and simmer it in water until tender, then drain any excess water.
Dice the onion and tomato, and slice the mushrooms.
Heat the olive oil in a pan and cook the onion and mushrooms until softened.
Crumble the tofu into the pan and stir in the chickpeas, tomato, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Cook the mixture for a few minutes, then fold in the spinach until it wilts.
Combine the cooked millet and vegetable mixture in a baking dish.
Scatter the pumpkin seeds and chopped parsley over the top.
Bake until heated through and lightly golden, about 20 minutes.

recipe.title: Garlic tofu with brown rice and zucchini
recipe.description: Golden garlic tofu, tender zucchini and nutty brown rice come together in a simple skillet meal.
steps: Rinse the brown rice and simmer it in water until tender.
Cut the tofu into cubes, slice the zucchini and mince the garlic.
Warm the olive oil in a skillet and cook the tofu until golden on the edges.
Add the zucchini and garlic, then cook until the zucchini is tender.
Serve the tofu and zucchini over the brown rice.

recipe.title: Paprika-roasted chickpeas with carrot sticks
recipe.description: Crisp, warmly spiced chickpeas make a simple match for fresh carrot sticks.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C.
Drain and dry the chickpeas, then toss them with the olive oil and paprika.
Roast the chickpeas for 20 minutes, shaking the tray once.
Cut the carrot into sticks and serve with the roasted chickpeas.

recipe.title: Roasted turkey with buckwheat, vegetables, and pumpkin seeds
recipe.description: Paprika-roasted turkey and vegetables are served with buckwheat and a crunchy pumpkin-seed finish.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C.
Rinse the buckwheat and simmer it in water until tender, about 15 minutes.
Cut the turkey, zucchini, and bell pepper into bite-sized pieces, and halve the mushrooms.
Slice the onion and mince the garlic.
Toss the turkey and vegetables with the olive oil and paprika, then spread them on a baking tray.
Roast for 20–25 minutes, turning once, until the turkey is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Toast the pumpkin seeds in a dry skillet until fragrant.
Chop the parsley and fold it through the cooked buckwheat.
Serve the roasted turkey and vegetables over the buckwheat, topped with pumpkin seeds.
